title: Playboy November 2007 Bunnies of Vegas Robert Redford Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, November 2007. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Bunny Lindsey Roeper.

Cover features: Real Bunnies of Vegas; Robert Redford - a rare interview; Chuck Liddell profile - chillin' with the Iceman; Matt Leinart 20Q; Barry Bonds's mistress tells all; Fred Thompson; video game blowout; Paul Wolfowitz - the untold story.

Back cover: Patron Silver tequila ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
